correctness.rationale: Summing the printed continuous SIAQR equations gives the exact identity g1+g2+g3+g4+g5=0, hence Caputo linearity yields exact population conservation. Equation (5.22) visibly uses R in its first recovery history sum but Q in its second and third recovery differences. For the invariant submodel I=A=Q=0, N=1, delta=omega=1/2, gamma=1/2, the exact solution is R(t)=E_{1/2}(-sqrt(t))=exp(t) erfc(sqrt(t)). Substitution into the printed m=2 recurrence leaves a nonzero total-population residual -0.49207893684378897699. The bundled checker reconstructs all coefficients directly from the displayed recurrence and independently reproduces the residual.

value.rationale: Exact total-population conservation is a central structural constraint of the closed SIAQR model. The printed recovery update violates it by nearly one half of the population on a simple exact fractional history, so the defect is not a cosmetic variable label in the displayed algorithm. The result supplies both an exact reproducibility diagnostic and a minimal componentwise repair while carefully withholding claims about unavailable simulation code.
